subject: Evaluation materials exchange: prompt pack, testcases & sandbox access
messages:
From: Dan Porter <dan.porter@brightretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14 09:12 -0700
Subject: Exchange of eval materials and MAP for pilot

Monica —

Thanks again for the demo this week. We want to run a focused 4-week pilot to validate latency, cost per 1k tokens, and some targeted prompt robustness checks. To move fast, could Redwood provide:

- A prompt pack (representative prompts + instructions) we can run against a small subset of testcases.
- A CSV of ~500 labeled testcases (subset) for functional checks.
- A short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones, acceptance criteria, and expected timelines.

Two quick constraints from our side: BrightRetail cannot publish results on a public leaderboard or redistribute the dataset to third parties. We also need an audit trail/audit logs for compliance.

Can you share a proposed MAP and how you typically manage access (S3 presigned vs. direct sandbox access)? We'll need sign-off from our security and legal (cc'ing Sabrina and legal shortly).

Appreciate it —
Dan
Principal Data Scientist, BrightRetail
[Attachment: request_summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Dan Porter <dan.porter@brightretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14 11:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval materials and MAP for pilot

Dan — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a proposed MAP and the prompt pack + testcase subset to get you started. High level below and next steps at the bottom.

Summary (proposed):
- Week 0 (Oct 19): MAA (Mutual Access Agreement) signed by both sides — DocuSign link included.
- Week 1 (Oct 20–24): Prompt pack + testcase subset delivered via presigned S3 links. We provide a short README and runbook.
- Week 2–3 (Oct 27–Nov 7): BrightRetail runs evaluation in sandbox (options below). Redwood collects telemetry summary (latency, tokens, error rates).
- Week 4 (Nov 10): Acceptance checkpoint — signoff on acceptance criteria or list of regressions and remediation plan.
- Post-eval: Data retention/destruction: artifacts returned/removed within 60 days of sign-off unless extended by mutual written agreement.

Access & sandbox options:
1) Presigned S3 links — standard (links expire after 7 days).
2) Dedicated sandbox in Redwood Private (VPC) — recommended if you want isolated network and longer-term access; requires a short setup call (48–72h).
3) If you require running on your VPC, we can provide an encrypted transfer and a short checklist for on-prem runs.

Usage constraints (we propose):
- No public benchmarking or leaderboard publication without mutual written approval.
- No redistribution to third parties.
- Analysis for internal evaluation and product development only.
- Redwood will maintain audit logs for access; we'll provide a one-time export to BrightRetail security during review.

Attachments included:
- MAP_v1.1.pdf [Milestones, deliverables, acceptance criteria]
- BR_eval_promptpack_v1.zip [Representative prompts & README]
- testcases_subset.csv [~500 rows, labeled]

Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/BR-2026-0917
- DocuSign (MAA): https://www.docusign.com/BR-2026-MAA-placeholder

Next steps (simple):
1) Quick legal review from BrightRetail — confirm the no-public-benchmark clause and retention window.
2) If OK, sign Docusign by Oct 19 so we can deliver the package on Oct 20.
3) Kickoff call (30m) for sandbox/runbook — propose Oct 21 or Oct 22.

Looping in Karthik (security) and Ben (CS lead) to help with any technical constraints.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Reliable LLM inference for product teams
[Attachment stubs: MAP_v1.1.pdf (pdf), BR_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (zip), testcases_subset.csv (csv)]

From: Dan Porter <dan.porter@brightretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sabrina Li <sabrina.li@brightretail.com>, Legal Team <legal@brightretail.com>
Date: 2026-10-15 08:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval materials and MAP for pilot

Monica — thanks, this looks good and very helpful. A couple of tiny asks from our security/legal review:

1) "No public benchmarking" — we need that spelled out as "no benchmarking or leaderboard publication without mutual written consent".
2) Retention period — our legal asks for the materials to be retained for 60 days after the evaluation ends; can you confirm Redwood can certify deletion and provide a deletion certificate?

Also: Is the Redwood Private sandbox a separate isolated tenancy? Sabrina from our security team would like to understand who at Redwood will have access to the artifacts during the evaluation (audit logs are great).

If you can incorporate those two items and re-issue the MAP, we can aim to sign by Oct 19. Happy to take the kickoff on Oct 21 (afternoon PST).

Thanks —
Dan
Principal Data Scientist, BrightRetail

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Dan Porter <dan.porter@brightretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-16 16:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval materials and MAP for pilot

Dan / Sabrina / BrightRetail legal —

Thanks for the quick review and concrete asks. We can accommodate both items:

1) Clause language — we'll update MAP_v1.1 to include the exact wording you requested: "No benchmarking, leaderboard publication, or public release of evaluation results without mutual written consent." We'll mark that as section 4.2 in MAP_v1.2 and resend.

2) Retention & deletion certification — Redwood will hold the test artifacts for 60 days after the evaluation end date by default. We will produce a deletion certificate (simple signed statement + system logs export) within 7 days of deletion. That will be attached to the HubSpot deal record and shared to legal.

Sandbox & access notes:
- Redwood Private sandbox is an isolated tenancy with restricted access; only named engineers on the MAP have access (we'll list them in MAP_v1.2).
- Audit logs: we keep access logs (S3 GETs, user principal, timestamp) and will provide a one-time export for your security review.
- Presigned links: we'll issue presigned S3 links for initial delivery (links expire in 7 days). If you sign the MAA and want longer access, we'll provision the Private sandbox (48–72h).

Next steps (action items):
- Monica: update MAP (v1.2) and re-upload to DocuSign by Oct 17 EOD.
- Dan/Sabrina: legal review + sign MAA by Oct 19.
- Karthik/Ben: prep runbook and checklist; Ben will schedule the Oct 21 kickoff (30m).

I'll also attach the updated MAP and a short checklist for the Private sandbox setup. If you prefer we can run the sandbox onboarding on Oct 20 (morning).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment stubs: MAP_v1.2.pdf (pdf), sandbox_runbook.md (md)]
